name: cf-cdn-input-validator
description: Validates the operator-filled user_input.csv against dns_manifest.yaml to ensure every proxied domain has a valid origin URL, cache policy selection, and routing configuration. Checks for required columns, valid enum values, reachable origin hostnames, and consistent ACM certificate groupings. On success, produces domain_scope.json — a machine-readable domain registry used by all downstream CDN pipeline subagents. Reports validation errors with clear remediation hints.
